thread:
alex: Heads up — planned maintenance in us-west2 this Saturday 03:00–07:00 UTC. We'll apply a NIC microcode patch and a subtle GPU microcode uplift on rack cluster-43 (5 cohorts). Expect rolling node drains and reboots with transient capacity reduction up to ~15% in hosted pools. Affected: hosted-api, dedicated-pool-west, private-vpc-us-west2. Procedure: drain cohort -> reboot nodes -> 30m canary (2 nodes) -> continue. Rollback if p50 latency > 250ms (5m) or error rate >1.5x. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/us-west2-microcode

tanya: Can we start at 03:30 instead? Saturday traffic dips later, minimizes customer impact.

alex: 03:30 is OK. Updating ticket and calendar.

jonah: Check for pinned Dedicated tenants on cluster-43. Command: `infractl tenants --rack cluster-43 --json | jq '.[] | select(.pinned==true)'

alex: Found pinned tenants on 43a and 43b (2 tenants). @tanya please loop SE/CS for scheduled failover and customer comms.

infra-bot: [automation] Created maintenance ticket MNT-178888 and added calendar event. Notifying reserved-tenants and oncall channels.

eva: Quick cost calc — region ~300 GPUs, 15% loss => ~45 GPUs. Window 3.5h average => 157.5 GPU-hours. At internal $2/hr ~ $315. Marking for finance.

paul: Add explicit abort conditions: (1) available GPUs < 20% baseline, (2) hosted-api p50 > 300ms for 5m, (3) canary failrate >1%. On any trigger, revert microcode and reintroduce nodes.

alex: Will codify triggers into automation and the runbook.

tanya: Customer Synthly has a demo 04:30 UTC — can we ensure their traffic hits eu-west fallback? @jonah can you validate region routing and TTLs?

jonah: Synthly uses dedicated-pool-west with cross-region failover to eu-west1. I'll verify DNS TTL and run a simulated failover: `curl -v https://synthly-app.redwood.dev/health --resolve synthly-app.redwood.dev:443:52.19.88.10`

ops-oncall: I'll stand by with temporary monitors: hosted-api p50 > 250ms (5m), request error rate +0.5% (3m), host_evictions >2 (10m). Will escalate if anything trips. :eyes:

alex: Also, pre-warm KV caches 45m before each cohort drain: `/bin/cache-seed --rack cluster-43 --duration 45m`. Set scheduler backpressure policy to `cold-shed` during the window to avoid p99 tail spikes.

tanya: Sounds good. I'll handle SE/CS comms. No objections from my side.

alex: If nobody objects by EOD Friday we'll proceed. After the window we'll post a short changelog + cost/impact note. :thumbsup:
